name: Yui Amano
want: be seen as cool and free, not as the heir to her family's dance school
secret: She is the heir of a traditional Japanese dance school and practises three hours every night in a kimono; she hides it to seem cool.
voice: Slang, "seriously?", nicknames for everyone; switches to perfect polite speech with adults without noticing.
description: Tanned, nail art, skirt shorter than the rules. Gets top marks in classical Japanese and nobody knows why.
appearance: Dyed honey-blonde hair, loose socks, a phone covered in charms.
